Sabato scorso sono andato al mare con la mia famiglia. Abbiamo preso il treno delle otto e siamo arrivati in due ore. Il tempo era bellissimo e l'acqua era calda. Abbiamo mangiato pesce fresco in un piccolo ristorante sul porto e siamo tornati a casa la sera.

Last Saturday I went to the seaside with my family. We took the eight o'clock train and arrived in two hours. The weather was beautiful and the water was warm. We ate fresh fish in a small restaurant on the harbor and returned home in the evening.
